auth.description: OpenRouter API key, sent as a bearer token
auth.name: openrouter.api_key
auth.subject: unstated

description: OpenRouter model router: list models and their endpoints, create chat completions, and read credit balance

operations.description: List every model OpenRouter routes to, with its context length, modalities and per-token pricing

data.description: One entry per model, each carrying at least `id` (`<author>/<slug>`), `name`, `created`, `description`, `context_length`, an `architecture` object and a `pricing` object whose per-token prices are decimal strings, not numbers

operations.description: List the upstream provider endpoints serving one model, with each one's pricing, context length and quantization

params.description: The model's author or organization, the part of a model id before the `/` — e.g. `openai`, `anthropic`, `meta-llama`
params.name: author

params.description: The model slug, the part of a model id after the `/` — e.g. `gpt-4`, `claude-3.5-sonnet`
params.name: slug

data.description: The model, with an `endpoints` array nested inside it — one entry per upstream provider serving it, each carrying its own `name`/`provider_name`, `context_length`, `pricing`, `quantization` and `supported_parameters`. This is a single object, not an array

operations.description: Create a chat completion through OpenRouter, routed to the named model. Billed per input and output token, so the caller must state a token budget via max_completion_tokens

params.description: The model to route to, as `<author>/<slug>` — e.g. `openai/gpt-4o` or `anthropic/claude-3.5-sonnet`
params.name: model

params.description: The conversation so far: a list of `{role, content}` objects, where role is one of system, developer, user, assistant or tool
params.name: messages

params.description: Upper bound on generated tokens, including reasoning tokens. Required by this connector so that every call states its cost bound
params.name: max_completion_tokens

choices.description: One entry per completion; this connector never sets `n`, so there is exactly one

error.description: Present when the upstream provider failed *after* routing succeeded: `{code, message, metadata}`, delivered with HTTP 200 and no content. Check for it before reading `message`

finish_reason.description: The normalized reason generation stopped — `stop`, `length`, `tool_calls`, `content_filter`. Branch on this one

message.description: The assistant's turn: `role`, `content`, and `tool_calls` when the model called a tool

native_finish_reason.description: The upstream provider's own unmapped reason, whose vocabulary varies by provider

id.description: The generation's id, which is also what `GET /api/v1/generation` would be queried by — an operation this connector cannot express (C-30)

model.description: The model that actually served the request. It can differ from the one asked for when routing falls back

provider.description: The upstream provider that served it, e.g. `Anthropic` or `Together`. OpenRouter's own addition to the OpenAI shape and not part of the documented response schema, so it is recorded as optional

usage.description: `prompt_tokens`, `completion_tokens`, `total_tokens`, and OpenRouter's own `cost` — what the call charged in credits, the same unit `openrouter-credits-get` reports

operations.description: Read the account's total purchased credits and total usage, in credit units

total_credits.description: Credits ever purchased on this account — a cumulative total, not a remaining balance

total_usage.description: Credits ever spent. The remaining balance is `total_credits - total_usage`
